name: WebMon
tagline: Interactive Web Component Picker, Visual + Code JSON/XML Mapper, 12 Adaptive Telemetry Cards, Resizable Desktop & iOS/iPad Widgets, Cross-Device iCloud Sync & Local Auth Vault
short_description: Native macOS, iOS/iPadOS & Windows 11 interactive web browser, visual DOM component selector, and Visual + Code JSON/XML Data Mapper that pins any website element or JSON/XML API path as a resizable floating desktop widget or iPhone/iPad Home & Lock Screen widget with 12 adaptive telemetry card styles, smart data dissolve & HTML stripping, custom static text/env vars/date-time tokens, per-item typography formatting, Sign in with Apple iCloud sync, live cadence auto-refresh, and local Keychain credential vault.
spotlight_description: WebMon v2.2.1 (Build 35) brings live web component pinning, a Visual + Code JSON & XML Structured Data Mapper, and full macOS ↔ iOS/iPadOS parity across 12 adaptive telemetry card styles, smart data dissolve, and custom token composition. Open any HTML webpage, JSON API endpoint (such as api.github.com/rate_limit), or XML/RSS feed in the built-in WebKit browser: tap or click to select DOM components or use the split Visual Field Tree + Code/Path Query Editor to target specific labels and values ($.a.b[0].c, /rss/channel/item[0]/title, and {{value}} / {{$.other.path}} templates). Compose custom widgets with Static Text, Environment Variables ($USER, $HOST, $SHELL), and Date/Time Presets with per-item typography formatting (Font Size, Weight, Style, Design & Color), and pin them as resizable Liquid Glass desktop widgets (with Header & Cross-Icon drag anchors) or iPhone/iPad Home, Lock Screen & ExtraLarge widgets that refresh automatically on your custom cadence (5s to 60m).
catalog_description: Native macOS, iOS & iPadOS WebKit component clipper, Visual + Code JSON & XML Structured Data Mapper, 12-style adaptive telemetry card engine, smart data dissolver, resizable floating desktop & Home/Lock Screen widget suite, live cadence refresh scheduler, Sign in with Apple cross-device iCloud sync, and local Keychain credential vault engineered in Swift 6. Features an interactive DOM element picker with scroll-anchored bounding-box overlays, automatic in-browser JSON/XML card formatting with visual tree + path query builder, Static Text / Environment Variable / Date-Time token items with per-item typography controls, Header & Cross-Icon drag anchors, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed, custom Solid/Gradient/Wallpaper widget backgrounds, pan & zoom viewport framing, and Low Effort Suite theme & icon sync.
